title: I FRMMY Bathtub Shower Mat Non Slip for Bathroom and Bath Tub with Drain Holes and Suction Cups
text: I FRMMY Bathtub Shower Mat Non Slip for Bathroom and Bath Tub with Drain Holes and Suction Cups. Very disappointing, does not stick to the tub moves all over the tub suction cups are worthless, I would not suggest this mat at all, it's nice and large and relatively soft but the fact it doesn't stick to the tub is not good, I did follow the suggestions of watering down the mat first and tub with water to get the suction still didn't work.

product_metadata.title: Bathtub Shower Mat Non Slip for Bathroom and Bath Tub with Drain Holes and Suction Cups, 26.8 x 15.4 Inch, Machine Washable (White)
features: Our bathtub mat is soft and flexible, give your feet or bottom the super comfortable use experience.
Anti-Slip: 126 suction cups help to hold in place on smooth tub surface. Secure suction cups before each use.
The anti-slip mat is equipped with drain holes, allowing water and soap to pass through and under the drain holes instead of pooling around your feet.
Machine Washable: Easy to keep the bathroom mat clean, free your hands, save your time.
Shower mat size-15.4 W x 26.8 L inches, fits any size bathtub or shower. WARNING: NOT suitable for non-smooth, textured surfaces!
